name: Media

mofsl_2qfy27.headline: No dedicated Media section in the 2QFY27 compendium (the sector pages run Automobiles to Utilities with no Media page)
mofsl_2qfy27.read: MOFSL covers 3 Media companies and prints no sector narrative or guidance. Its sector charts place Media near the middle of the 1HFY27 PAT-growth ranking (about +17%, chart reading) and show 2HFY27E PAT growth of roughly +39% (chart reading), while the incremental-PAT contribution table shows Media adding only about INR1b. No company surprises or misses are named, so company numbers must come from decks and broker notes.

unit_economics: Broadcaster: revenue = advertising (inventory x yield) + subscription (paying homes x rate) + film + franchise; house EBITDA = revenue - operating cost - content amortisation, excluding treasury income. Exhibition: footfall x ATP + F&B spend per head + advertising less rent and staff. Music: licensing and streaming revenue less royalty and amortised content cost.

price_drivers.why: Linear TV ad revenue fell 10.3% in 2025 and Sun and Zee ad lines fell YoY for ten straight quarters; ad stabilisation is the main re-rating trigger.
Sun domestic subscription growth slowed from 9-11% in FY26 to +2.3% in 2QFY27 as pay-TV homes fell to ~104mn.
Sun house margin fell from 44% to 38% in FY26 once film and rights amortisation is charged; film releases swing reported EBITDA by 40%+ in a quarter.
Sun holds ~Rs7,500 cr and other income is ~28% of PBT; payout and non-core use of cash decide the multiple on a 5-10x core P/E.
The 2028-32 IPL media rights auction (mid-CY27) and franchise deal marks (RCB INR166.6bn) determine the value of Sun's cricket line.

kpis.name: Advertising revenue growth
kpis.definition: TV advertising revenue (including slot sales) growth YoY and over two years, with radio shown separately.
kpis.why_it_moves_price: Ad revenue is the most cyclical and most de-rated line; Zee's ad line leads Sun's, and the ad-cap removal (announced Aug-2026) adds only ~1-3% industry inventory.
kpis.history_source: get_financials revenue split (Sun FY26 annual report); get_investor_presentation metric filter 'advertising' (ZEEL deck); broker results notes (JM, Kotak, IIFL) in the report library.
kpis.estimate_source: get_consensus_estimates gives Bloomberg Sales for SUNTV/ZEEL; ad-line forecasts come from broker models (ICICI Securities language-market ad model).
kpis.traps: BARC ratings suspended from Jul-2026; Sun broadcast-slot sales sit in ad revenue; FMCG A&P growth no longer correlates with TV ads.

kpis.name: Domestic subscription growth and related-party share
kpis.definition: Domestic and international subscription revenue growth, price versus subscriber split, and the share billed to promoter-group distributors.
kpis.why_it_moves_price: Subscription is ~48% of Sun's revenue and is price-led; growth fell to +2.3% in 2QFY27 and 56% of Sun's subscription comes from promoter-group distributors.
kpis.history_source: get_financials revenue lines; Sun annual report related-party note via read_library_document; transcripts (ZEEL; Sun calls are second-hand via brokers).
kpis.estimate_source: No consensus field; Bloomberg Sales only; NTO price-cycle commentary in broker notes.
kpis.traps: FIFA added 15-20pp to Zee's Q2 subscription growth; NTO price caps; TRAI quarterly data lags ~3 months.

kpis.name: Content-adjusted house EBITDA margin
kpis.definition: Revenue less operating cost less amortisation of film, programme and broadcasting rights, excluding other income.
kpis.why_it_moves_price: Sun reports EBITDA before film and rights amortisation (51.1% FY26) while brokers quote 40.7%; EV/EBITDA for the same stock ranges 4x to 11x on basis alone.
kpis.history_source: get_financials (D&A split, intangible notes in the annual report); broker results notes for house-basis EBITDA; Zee deck for programming cost.
kpis.estimate_source: get_consensus_estimates Bloomberg EBITDA / PAT / EPS (bases differ by broker); no consensus on content-adjusted EBITDA.
kpis.traps: Zee front-loaded movie amortisation from Q4FY26 (Rs4,084mn); film quarters spike EBITDA while EBIT barely moves; Zee Q2 EBITDA Rs708mn vs Rs858mn across brokers.

kpis.name: Content cost % of TV revenue
kpis.definition: Programme cost plus rights amortisation over advertising and subscription revenue; Zee on programming cost and inventory days.
kpis.formula: (Programme and production cost + rights amortisation) / (ad + subscription revenue)
kpis.why_it_moves_price: Sun ran 25.4% in FY26 and Zee 50-56%; Zee's inventory (~Rs65bn, ~293 days of revenue) and write-down risk drive its discount.
kpis.history_source: get_financials (inventories, programming cost); Sun annual report intangibles note; get_investor_presentation metric filter 'content' (ZEEL).
kpis.estimate_source: No consensus field; Broker models; Zee guidance on programming cost.
kpis.traps: Different cost locations (Sun D&A vs Zee COGS); inventory days on revenue vs on programming cost (293 vs ~500+).

kpis.name: Viewership and network share (BARC)
kpis.definition: Weekly network share of viewing by genre or language; shown as not available while BARC is suspended.
kpis.why_it_moves_price: Zee says share gains convert to revenue after 13-16 weeks; with BARC data suspended from Jul-2026 (news from Mar-2026) this lead indicator is blind.
kpis.history_source: Zee decks and transcripts (data stops at week 24 of 2026); broker sector notes; no Airavat structured series.
kpis.traps: Suspension of ratings; share claims use selective target groups and markets.

kpis.name: Film contribution, box office, footfalls, ATP and SPH
kpis.definition: Film revenue less same-period amortisation for producers; occupancy, average ticket price and spend per head for exhibitors.
kpis.formula: Film revenue - production amortisation; footfalls x ATP; F&B / footfalls
kpis.why_it_moves_price: Jailer 2 (Q3FY27) is expected to add Rs3.5-4bn of Sun revenue, while exhibitors re-rate on footfalls and spend per head, not screen count.
kpis.history_source: get_financials; get_investor_presentation metric filter 'footfalls' / 'ATP' / 'SPH' (PVRINOX); box-office trackers cited in broker notes.
kpis.estimate_source: No consensus field; Bloomberg Sales/EBITDA only; slate guidance in transcripts.
kpis.traps: Release-quarter EBITDA spikes; Ind AS 116 rent; box-office gross vs net.

kpis.name: Sports franchise revenue, fee and EBITDA (IPL, SA20, The Hundred)
kpis.definition: Cricket revenue, franchise fee (~20-23% of revenue) and EBITDA on a season basis (Q4 plus Q1 for the IPL).
kpis.formula: Cricket revenue - franchise fee - identifiable cricket costs
kpis.why_it_moves_price: Sun's cricket EBITDA margin fell from 50% to 36% in FY26; broker values of the cricket line span Rs70bn to Rs170bn, so the 2028-32 rights reset swings Sun's value.
kpis.history_source: get_financials segment lines; Sun annual report; broker results notes (Elara, Kotak, Axis) in the library.
kpis.estimate_source: No consensus field; Broker models only; no Bloomberg segment field.
kpis.traps: IPL straddles two fiscal quarters; central-pool income may be booked on estimate; Leeds franchise carried at indefinite life.

kpis.name: Treasury and other income % of PBT
kpis.definition: Cash and investments and other income share of profit before tax, with FVTPL gains separated.
kpis.why_it_moves_price: Sun's ~Rs7,540 cr treasury and other income at ~28.5% of standalone PBT mean P/E on group EPS flatters the core; brokers' core multiples run 5x to 12.4x depending on treatment.
kpis.history_source: get_financials other income and balance sheet; Sun annual report notes.
kpis.estimate_source: get_consensus_estimates Bloomberg PAT / EPS includes treasury income; no separate field.
kpis.traps: MTM gains on debt funds; aircraft advance and films under production are not treasury.

kpis.name: Music label licensing revenue and content amortisation
kpis.definition: Music licensing, streaming and film-rights revenue growth with royalty and content amortisation.
kpis.why_it_moves_price: Streaming and licensing revenue compounds at high-teens with 60%+ EBITDA margins at Tips and Saregama, which rerate on catalogue acquisitions and licence renewals.
kpis.estimate_source: No consensus field; Bloomberg Sales/EBITDA only.
kpis.traps: Lumpy film-music rights revenue; content amortisation policy differs; Zee Music P&L not disclosed.

macro_inputs.source: Broker sector notes in the library
Broker sector notes in the library
Airavat get_commodity_prices where available; broker notes

valuation_anchor: Broadcasters: SOTP with core media P/E on core media PAT ex treasury and ex franchises (street 5-12x), treasury at face net of DTL, franchises on deal marks; Zee on forward core EPS (9-18x) cross-checked with SOTP. Exhibition: EV/EBITDA on post-Ind AS 116 basis. Music: P/E on forward EPS.
watch_next_quarter: MOFSL gives no Media commentary; track Zee's Q3 print first, Sun's Jailer 2 film quarter, subscription price cycle (next round ~Feb-2027), BARC ratings resumption and ad-cap removal effects on 3QFY27 ad revenue, and the 2028-32 IPL rights process.
